step1.title: Fine-Grained Rendering in Depth
step1.description: We talk a lot about Signals on this stream but not nearly enough about how fine-grained rendering works. What makes Solid/Svelte 5 different than Preact/Qwik or React w/ Jotai? Why does everyone ignore Vue in Signals conversations? Why is fine-grained rendering more performant than VDOM? How does it work? Let's talk about the real reason everyone is talking about Signals.
